tags.description: A comic with a cover that has gone slightly purple the way cheap red ink does: a woman in welding leathers holding a length of rebar like a staff, standing in the doorway of a foundry with the light behind her. SHE WAS SOMEBODY’S SISTER FIRST. The interior paper is coarse enough to feel through the sleeve. Somebody has written a name in the top corner of the first page and then scribbled it out, badly.
